title: Protecting street animals is a shared responsibility: PM
summary: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya stated that while keeping companion animals has become an important part of our culture, protecting the lives and welfare of street animals is a shared responsibility of all.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several areas
summary: The Department of Meteorology has issued a warm weather advisory for the Eastern Province and the districts of Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu, Vavuniya and Monaragala tomorrow(18).

title: CSE turnover falls to lowest level since April 2025
summary:
The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) recorded a turnover of Rs. 722 million on Friday, marking its lowest daily turnover since 17 April 2025.
The All Share Price Index (ASPI) also declined by 42.16 points, closing at 21,405.41.

title: Money laundering case against Yoshitha: Further evidence hearings postponed
summary: The Colombo High Court has postponed further evidence hearings in the money laundering case filed against Yoshitha Rajapaksa, son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, until 24 July.
